patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient has been experiencing progressive left leg pain for 2 months, with recent interference with sleep. The pain was initially treated as 'growing pains' with ibuprofen, without improvement. He recalls being hit in the thigh by a baseball one week before the onset of symptoms, resulting in redness and swelling that lasted several days.

Secondary_Symptoms: History of trauma to the leg

patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: No fever, weight loss, or other systemic symptoms reported.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with progressive left leg pain and assess the pathological causes.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’m a 13-year-old boy, and for the past two months I’ve had worsening pain in my left leg that’s been waking me up and keeping me from sleeping. About a week before it started, I got hit on the thigh by a baseball, and I had redness and swelling for a few days afterward, but the pain never really went away.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your symptoms, have you noticed any changes in your eyesight, such as blurriness, dark spots, or any degree of vision loss?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my eyesight—no blurriness, dark spots, or vision loss. It’s mainly the increasing pain in my left leg that’s been bothering me and affecting my sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t smoke, and I’ve never smoked.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nausea or felt sick to my stomach. It’s mostly just the worsening pain in my left leg, and it’s been getting bad enough to wake me up at night.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t have any breast lumps or masses, and I haven’t noticed anything in that area.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that physical symptoms can often be linked to how we are feeling overall. Lately, have you been experiencing a significant amount of stress or emotional strain in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been under any unusual stress or emotional strain—school and baseball are about the same. It’s mainly the worsening pain in my left leg that’s been stressing me out because it keeps me from sleeping.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your current health, have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine, such as it appearing darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any changes in the color of my urine—it's been normal to me. I’m mainly dealing with the worsening pain in my left leg, especially at night.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that finding a change in your breast can be concerning. To help me better understand what you are experiencing, could you tell me if you have noticed this mass growing or changing in size rapidly over a short period of time?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any breast mass at all, so nothing has been growing or changing quickly. It’s all been focused on the worsening pain in my left leg and how it wakes me up at night.”

turns.doctor_question: I'm sorry to hear you're not feeling well. To help me better understand what might be going on, could you tell me if you have been experiencing any pain in your wrist?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any pain in my wrist—my pain is only in my left leg. It’s been getting worse over the last two months and it even wakes me up at night.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a clearer picture of what’s going on, could you please check your arms for me? Have you noticed any skin lesions, such as rashes, bumps, or marks, running along the path of the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or marks running along the veins in my arms. My main issue is still the progressively worsening pain in my left leg that wakes me up at night.”
